Title: Wonder Woman Vol 4 23

URL Source: https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_4_23

Markdown Content:
****_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 4) #23**** is an issue of the series [_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 4)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_4 "Wonder Woman Vol 4") with a cover date of [October, 2013](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2013,_October "Category:2013, October"). It was published on August 21, 2013.

## Synopsis for "God Down"

[Wonder Woman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_(Diana_Prince) "Wonder Woman (Diana Prince)") and her companions have just returned to [London](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/London "London") from [New Genesis](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/New_Genesis "New Genesis"), only to find that in their absence, the [First Born](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/First_Born_(Prime_Earth) "First Born (Prime Earth)") has laid waste to the city. Faced with the armies of the First Born, [War](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Ares_(Prime_Earth) "Ares (Prime Earth)") begins to shuffle away, tearing down the walls of [Westminster Abbey](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Westminster_Abbey "Westminster Abbey") to reveal that he has brought his _own_ army - every single soldier who ever had a song sung about him throughout history. These warriors remind Diana of her lost [Amazonian](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Amazons "Amazons") sisters, and War admits that these men would probably take that as a compliment.

With war breaking out all around them, [Hera](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Hera_(Prime_Earth) "Hera (Prime Earth)") realizes that she must get [Zola](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Zola_(Prime_Earth) "Zola (Prime Earth)") and [Zeke](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Zeus_(Prime_Earth) "Zeus (Prime Earth)") to safety. They try to run for their lives, but all the same, Zola is sure that her baby boy will see them through it all safely. [Orion](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Orion_(Prime_Earth) "Orion (Prime Earth)"), meanwhile, attacks the First Born, unafraid of the hulking god. For all his bravado, though, he finds himself crushed beneath a stone pillar.

Angrily, Wonder Woman warns the First Born that she will make him pay for what he's done, and he points out that he can _smell_ her hatred. War warns that as much as she might want to avenge [Lennox](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Lennox_(Prime_Earth) "Lennox (Prime Earth)"), if she rushes in without any control, she could lose herself. Eyes glowing with power, Diana removes her [Bracelets of Submission](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Bracelets_of_Submission "Bracelets of Submission"), which keep her power limited, and leaps at the First Born, launching him into the sky. Relentlessly she punches him, warning that if she must destroy him to stop him, she will not hesitate. He responds that she _just_ hesitated, and reverses their situation, plunging with her back toward the ground, and slamming her into the hard earth.

With Diana down, the First Born turns his attention to Zeke, the child of prophecy. Hera, the First Born's mother, stands between them, and he becomes angry with her. Angrily, War fires a shot from a gun at the First Born's head to turn his attention to challenging _him_.

Wincing, Diana rises, and admits to Zola that War had been right about her. Sometimes, it is best not to be who one _is_, but rather who one aspires to _be_. She collects her gauntlets from the ground and returns to the First Born, watching as he prepares to kill War and take his title as God of War. Knowing there is little time left, Diana thrusts her spear _through_ War's back and into the First Born's chest. As he lies dying, Diana apologizes to War, but he absolves her, admitting that it was the warrior's path, and he would have done the same. He apologizes, though, for the burden that he must now place on her shoulders. As he dies, he addresses her as Wonder Woman, and asks her to keep him in her heart.

Angrily, the First Born attempts to rise up, but Zola clubs him over the head, and he remains down. With War dead, [Hell](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Hades_(Prime_Earth) "Hades (Prime Earth)") appears, and warns that it is time for War to go with him. Sadly, Hera stops him, and begs the chance to say goodbye to her son. She kisses him on his bald head, and wishes him the peace in death that eluded him in life. Diana decides to leave the First Born alive, for now, giving [Apollo](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Phoebus_Apollo_(Prime_Earth) "Phoebus Apollo (Prime Earth)") the chance to take him for himself. Meanwhile, Diana and Hell carry War's body to the ferry, and head down the River Styx to his final reward.

## Appearing in "God Down"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [Wonder Woman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Diana_of_Themyscira_(Prime_Earth) "Diana of Themyscira (Prime Earth)")
